zh.summary: 更換工具時保留已確認需求、權限與驗收契約，依變更影響規劃回歸，不用品牌或版本代替工程判斷。
objectives: 區分可替換工具與需要持續維持的責任。
說明 Agent、框架及多人需求改變的不同影響。
為遷移設定驗收與復原條件。

readingGuide.goal: 區分可替換工具與需要持續維持的責任。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 既有作品與測試紀錄，選擇一項假設的工具替換；本練習不必安裝新產品或使用真實資料。
readingGuide.route: 先理解情境與原理，再對照工作坊檔案，最後留下可核對的操作與審查紀錄。
readingGuide.output: 一份有範圍、驗收及復原條件的遷移計畫，不假裝新工具已通過實測。

sections.heading: 工具會變，判斷依據要能帶走
paragraphs: 模型、Coding Agent、框架及套件持續變動。換工具前先說明想改善什麼，以及哪些既有行為必須保持；單靠新版本名稱，無法判斷是否值得遷移。
本課長期保留的是問題定義、使用者任務、規格、資料與權限邊界、可核對驗證及交接。工具能協助執行，需求與接受結果仍要有明確負責人。

sections.heading: 像換一組施工工具，仍需遵守圖面與驗收
paragraphs: 更換工具可能提高效率，也可能需要新的操作與安全條件。不能因工具更新，就自行改掉尺寸、用途或責任範圍。
軟體遷移同樣先看變更影響。換 Agent 主要改開發流程，換 UI 框架可能改執行與部署，從單人到多人則新增身分與資料治理需求；三者不能當成同一種更新。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜工具變更下的共同責任
blocks.description: 平行卡片是同時需要維持的契約，不是以新工具取代前一項。

items.title: 問題與使用者
items.body: 仍要知道誰需要何種結果。

items.title: 規格與邊界
items.body: 保留驗收、資料、權限與不做事項。

items.title: 驗證與復原
items.body: 檢查受影響行為，保存可回復版本。

items.title: 交接與負責人
items.body: 更新環境、操作、限制與決策紀錄。

sections.heading: 依替換範圍選擇回歸
paragraphs: 若替換 Coding Agent，要確認新工具能讀取正確來源、受允許路徑與工具限制、產生可審查 Diff，並留下實際命令結果。程式若未變，也不能聲稱新 Agent 已完成實作驗收。
若改 UI 框架，規則函式可能仍可沿用，但畫面狀態、輸入提交、下載、鍵盤、依賴與部署方式都需要重新核對。不要僅跑原規則測試就宣布遷移完成。

blocks.caption: 表 1｜不同變更，不同驗收
rows: 來源讀取、工具權限、修改及回報
狀態、鍵盤、下載、環境與部署
資料完整性及既有任務
身分、每次資料存取授權、儲存與治理

sections.heading: 先定義遷移驗收與復原點
paragraphs: 保留目前可用提交與測試結果，在獨立副本或分支逐項替換。為這次變更列出代表任務、負向案例、通過條件及停止條件，再觀察實際差異。
若權限需求不清、輸出契約改變或核心任務無法完成，先保存證據並停在該範圍，不把未決要求交給 Agent 自行補完。需要復原時依明確來源與路徑處理，保留其他工作。

sections.heading: 用風險與證據安排人類決策
paragraphs: NIST AI RMF 提供自願使用的風險管理框架，協助組織把責任與風險考量帶進 AI 系統設計、使用與評估；引用框架不代表已通過認證或符合所有正式規定。
本課將責任落在具體問題：誰確認業務規則？誰能授權工具？誰接受目前版本？誰處理資料與後續維運？寫明負責角色、依據與未決項目，避免把模型回覆當成責任移轉。

sections.heading: 沿著同一條路線持續改善
paragraphs: 保留使用者回饋與實際錯誤，從一個可觀察問題開始下一輪：重新確認需求、調整設計與規格、小步修改、驗證並交接。不要為了追逐新工具，無限重啟已延後的功能。
完成這個系列後，應能拿出問題、設計、規格、架構、可執行原型、測試、README 與 Git 證據，也能說明哪些仍未實作或未驗。這份責任與方法可以帶到其他合成產業案例，正式導入仍依實際需求驗證。

exercise.environment: 既有作品與測試紀錄，選擇一項假設的工具替換；本練習不必安裝新產品或使用真實資料。
steps: 寫下替換目的、維持不變的契約，以及會影響哪些執行層次。
列出代表任務、負向案例、權限與環境檢查，以及停止及復原條件。
標記目前是遷移計畫、已執行或已驗收；沒有執行就保留未執行。
exercise.expected: 一份有範圍、驗收及復原條件的遷移計畫，不假裝新工具已通過實測。
exercise.check: 不同變更對應不同回歸；保留人類負責角色與原型限制。
exercise.cleanup: 保留計畫與未決項目，不因本篇閱讀而自動安裝、付費或部署新服務。

en.summary: When replacing tools, preserve confirmed requirements, permissions and acceptance contracts, choosing regression checks by impact rather than brand or version.
objectives: Distinguish replaceable tools from continuing responsibilities.
Explain different impacts of Agent, framework and multiuser changes.
Define migration acceptance and recovery conditions.

readingGuide.goal: Distinguish replaceable tools from continuing responsibilities.
readingGuide.startingPoint: Existing artifacts/tests and one hypothetical tool replacement; no new product installation or real data is required.
readingGuide.route: Understand the situation and principles, compare the workshop files, then retain verifiable operation and review records.
readingGuide.output: A scoped migration plan with acceptance and recovery conditions, without claiming an untested tool passed.

sections.heading: Carry Decision Criteria Across Tool Changes
paragraphs: Models, Coding Agents, frameworks and packages change. Identify the intended improvement and behavior to preserve before switching. A new version name alone does not establish the value of migration.

The course’s durable responsibilities are problem definition, user tasks, specifications, data/permission boundaries, verifiable evidence and handoff. Tools help execute work; requirements and acceptance still need named human owners.

sections.heading: New Construction Tools Still Follow Plans and Inspection
paragraphs: Replacement tools may improve efficiency or introduce operating/safety conditions. They do not authorize changes to agreed dimensions, purpose or responsibility.

Software migrations likewise depend on impact. Agent replacement mainly changes development work, a UI framework may change runtime/deployment, and moving to multiple users adds identity/data governance. These are different changes.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Responsibilities Across Tool Changes
blocks.description: These parallel contracts remain together; a new tool does not replace an earlier responsibility.

items.title: Specification and boundaries
items.body: Retain acceptance, data, permissions and exclusions.

items.title: Verification and recovery
items.body: Check affected behavior and keep a recoverable version.

items.title: Handoff and owners
items.body: Update environments, operations, limits and decisions.

sections.heading: Select Regression Checks for the Replacement Scope
paragraphs: For a replacement Coding Agent, check source access, allowed paths/tools, reviewable diffs and actual command reports. Unchanged code alone does not establish that the new Agent completed an implementation task.

For a UI-framework migration, rule functions may remain reusable, but state, committed input, downloads, keyboard behavior, dependencies and deployment all need review. Passing old rule tests alone does not establish completed migration.

blocks.caption: Table 1 | Different Changes Need Different Acceptance
rows: Source reading, permissions, changes and reports.
State, keyboard, downloads, environment and deployment.
Move from one user to many
Identity, authorization at each data access, storage and governance.

sections.heading: Define Acceptance and a Recovery Point First
paragraphs: Keep the current working commit and test results, then replace parts in a separate copy or branch. Define representative tasks, negative cases, pass criteria and stop conditions before observing actual differences.

If permissions are unclear, outputs change or a core task fails, retain evidence and stop the affected scope rather than letting an Agent invent requirements. Recover from explicit sources/paths while preserving other work.

sections.heading: Place Human Decisions Around Risk and Evidence
paragraphs: NIST AI RMF is a voluntary risk-management framework supporting responsibility and risk considerations in AI-system design, use and evaluation. Referencing it establishes neither certification nor compliance with every formal rule.

Make responsibility concrete: who confirms business rules, authorizes tools, accepts this version and manages data/operations? Record roles, evidence and unresolved matters; model responses do not transfer responsibility.

sections.heading: Continue Along the Same Improvement Route
paragraphs: Retain user feedback and actual errors. Begin another cycle from an observable problem: reconfirm needs, adjust design/specification, change incrementally, verify and hand over. Do not endlessly reactivate deferred features to chase new tools.

After this series, learners should be able to present problem, design, specification, architecture, runnable prototype, tests, README and Git evidence, explaining what remains absent or unverified. The method transfers to other synthetic industry cases; formal adoption still needs context-specific verification.

exercise.environment: Existing artifacts/tests and one hypothetical tool replacement; no new product installation or real data is required.
steps: State the replacement goal, contracts to preserve and affected execution layers.
List representative tasks, negative cases, permission/environment checks and stop/recovery conditions.
Mark whether work is a plan, executed change or accepted result; preserve unexecuted status when nothing ran.
exercise.expected: A scoped migration plan with acceptance and recovery conditions, without claiming an untested tool passed.
exercise.check: Match regression scope to the change; retain human owners and prototype limits.
exercise.cleanup: Keep the plan and open decisions. Reading this lesson does not trigger installation, payment or deployment.

zh.prompt: 替換 UI 框架後，只跑原規則測試足夠嗎？
options: 不夠，還需核對狀態、鍵盤、下載及環境等影響

en.prompt: After replacing the UI framework, are old rule tests sufficient?
options: Yes; the interface cannot affect behavior.
Yes; the new framework guarantees quality.
No; review affected state, keyboard, downloads, environment and other behavior.
rationales: A clear plan can support migration.

zh.prompt: 採用 NIST AI RMF 可以直接宣稱什麼？
options: 可參考其風險管理框架，實際控制仍需驗證
正式業務規則自動成立
所有人類責任已移交模型
rationales: 保留框架與實作的界線。

en.prompt: What may adopting NIST AI RMF directly support?
options: Use of its risk-management framework; actual controls still need verification.
All human responsibility transfers to the model.
rationales: Tools do not automatically assume responsibility.

zh.prompt: 只寫好遷移計畫，應標記什麼？
options: 計畫已準備，操作與驗收尚未執行

en.prompt: Only a migration plan has been written. What status fits?
options: Plan prepared; operation and acceptance not performed.
